name: London
note: 这里的摘句写的是整座伦敦；城里的具体地点各有标记
note_en: The excerpts here are about London as a whole; places inside the city have markers of their own

name: The Tabard, Southwark
name_zh: 南华克 · 泰巴德客栈旧址
note: 博罗高街上泰巴德客栈的旧址，乔叟的朝圣者在这里集合；客栈 1873 年已拆除
note_en: Site of the Tabard inn on Borough High Street, where Chaucer's pilgrims gather; the inn was pulled down in 1873

name: Canterbury Cathedral
note: 坎特伯雷大主教的座堂；乔叟笔下朝圣者要去的托马斯·贝克特圣龛曾在这里，1538 年被毁
note_en: Seat of the Archbishop of Canterbury; Thomas Becket's shrine, the goal of Chaucer's pilgrims, stood here until it was destroyed in 1538

name: Ely Place, Holborn
name_zh: 霍尔本 · 伊利府旧址
note: 一条有门禁的私家街道，原是伊利主教的伦敦府邸，莎士比亚把冈特的约翰临终一场设在这里
note_en: A gated private street on the site of the Bishop of Ely's London palace, where Shakespeare sets John of Gaunt's deathbed

name: Inverness
note: 尼斯河口的高地首府，莎士比亚把麦克白的城堡放在这里
note_en: The Highland capital at the mouth of the River Ness, where Shakespeare places Macbeth's castle

name: Birnam Wood
note: 邓凯尔德附近泰河边的树林；那里有一棵老树被称作“勃南橡树”
note_en: Woods by the River Tay near Dunkeld; an old tree there is called the Birnam Oak

name: Dunsinane Hill
note: 珀斯东北锡德洛丘陵中的一座山，山顶有铁器时代堡垒的遗迹
note_en: A hill in the Sidlaws north-east of Perth, with the remains of an Iron Age fort on top

name: St Paul's Cathedral
note: 拉德盖特山上的大教堂，1666 年伦敦大火后由克里斯托弗·雷恩重建
note_en: The cathedral on Ludgate Hill that Christopher Wren rebuilt after the Great Fire of 1666

name: Scottish Highlands
note: 苏格兰北部和西部的山地；诗里说的是整个高地，所以标记只放在大致中间
note_en: The mountainous north and west of Scotland; the poem means the Highlands as a whole, so the marker sits roughly in the middle

name: Westminster Bridge
note: 连接威斯敏斯特和兰贝斯的桥；现在的桥 1862 年建成，取代了华兹华斯走过的老桥
note_en: The bridge between Westminster and Lambeth; the present one opened in 1862, replacing the bridge Wordsworth crossed

name: Tintern Abbey
note: 怀伊河谷中的西多会修道院遗址；华兹华斯的诗是在它上游几英里的河边写的
note_en: The ruins of a Cistercian abbey in the Wye valley; Wordsworth's lines were written on the river a few miles upstream

name: The Cobb, Lyme Regis
name_zh: 莱姆里吉斯 · Cobb 堤岸
note: 多塞特郡莱姆里吉斯港口弧形的石砌防波堤
note_en: The curving stone harbour wall at Lyme Regis in Dorset

name: Lincoln's Inn
note: 伦敦四大律师学院之一，大律师的事务所设在这里
note_en: One of the four Inns of Court, where barristers have their chambers

name: Edinburgh
note: 苏格兰首府；摘句写的是整座城市，所以标记放在城市中心的老城
note_en: Scotland's capital; the excerpt describes the whole city, so the marker sits in the Old Town at its heart

name: Baker Street
note: 马里波恩的一条街；柯南·道尔把福尔摩斯的寓所放在 221B，当时并没有这个门牌号
note_en: A Marylebone street; Conan Doyle put Holmes's rooms at 221B, a number that did not exist then

name: Whitby Abbey
note: 惠特比东崖上的本笃会修道院遗址，要爬 199 级台阶上去
note_en: The ruined Benedictine abbey on the East Cliff above Whitby, reached by the 199 steps

name: Tower of London
note: 泰晤士河畔的诺曼城堡，做过王宫、监狱和刑场
note_en: The Norman fortress on the Thames that served as palace, prison and place of execution

name: Westminster · Big Ben
name_zh: 威斯敏斯特 · 大本钟
note: 威斯敏斯特宫钟楼里的大钟，钟楼现名伊丽莎白塔
note_en: The great bell in the clock tower of the Palace of Westminster, now called the Elizabeth Tower

name: River Cam at King's College
note: 康河流经国王学院、沿“后园”（the Backs）的一段
note_en: The stretch of the Cam that runs past King's College along the Backs

name: St Giles' Churchyard, Stoke Poges
name_zh: 斯托克波吉斯 · 圣贾尔斯教堂墓园
prototype_of: 传统上认为是《墓畔哀歌》里的乡村墓园，但学界并无定论
prototype_of_en: Traditionally taken as the country churchyard of Gray's Elegy, though not all scholars agree
coord_checked: Church of St Giles, Stoke Poges — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Church_of_St_Giles,_Stoke_Poges

name: St Cross water meadows, Winchester
name_zh: 温彻斯特 · St Cross 水草甸
prototype_of: 诗中没有点名：1819 年 9 月济慈常沿这片水草甸散步，他写信告诉朋友，是星期天散步时看到的收割后的田野让他写下了这首诗；这条路线被普遍认为就是《秋颂》的风景
prototype_of_en: Not named in the poem: Keats walked these water meadows in September 1819 and told a friend in a letter that the stubble fields on his Sunday walk made him write it; the route is widely taken as the landscape of To Autumn

name: Top Withens, Haworth Moor
prototype_of: 常被和呼啸山庄联系在一起，主要是因为这里荒凉的高沼环境；不过废墟上勃朗特学会的牌子写明，这座农舍本身和艾米莉笔下的房子并不相像
prototype_of_en: Often linked with Wuthering Heights for its bleak moorland setting, though the Brontë Society's plaque at the ruin says the farmhouse itself bore no resemblance to the house Emily described

name: Poets' Corner, Westminster Abbey
name_zh: 威斯敏斯特教堂 · 诗人角
note: 乔叟 1400 年葬在这里，是第一位葬在这里的诗人，主要因为他当过威斯敏斯特宫的工程总管，而不是因为诗名；1599 年斯宾塞葬在附近，才开了这个传统。德莱顿、约翰逊、勃朗宁、丁尼生、狄更斯、哈代（骨灰）和吉卜林也葬在这里，还有更多作家在这里立了纪念碑，从莎士比亚、弥尔顿到勃朗特三姐妹和迪伦·托马斯
note_en: Chaucer was the first poet buried here, in 1400, more because he had been Clerk of Works of the Palace of Westminster than for his poems; Spenser's burial nearby in 1599 began the tradition. Dryden, Johnson, Browning, Tennyson, Dickens, Hardy (his ashes) and Kipling are buried here too, and many more writers have memorials, from Shakespeare and Milton to the Brontë sisters and Dylan Thomas

name: Shakespeare's Birthplace
note: 斯特拉特福亨利街
note_en: Henley Street, Stratford-upon-Avon

name: Dove Cottage, Grasmere
note: 华兹华斯故居
note_en: Wordsworth's home

name: Keats House, Hampstead
name_zh: 汉普斯特德 · 济慈故居
note: 济慈故居
note_en: Keats's home

name: Jane Austen's House, Chawton
name_zh: 乔顿 · 简·奥斯汀故居
note: 奥斯汀晚年在此写作
note_en: Where Austen did her later writing

name: Brontë Parsonage Museum, Haworth
name_zh: 霍沃斯 · 勃朗特牧师住宅博物馆
note: 1820 年父亲帕特里克出任霍沃斯的牧师，勃朗特一家搬进这座牧师住宅。夏洛蒂、艾米莉和安妮一生大部分时间住在这里，周围的荒原贯穿她们的小说。1928 年起成为博物馆，由勃朗特学会管理
note_en: The Brontës' home from 1820, when their father Patrick became vicar of Haworth. Charlotte, Emily and Anne spent most of their lives here, and the moors around it run through their novels. A museum since 1928, run by the Brontë Society

name: Charles Dickens Museum
note: 道蒂街 48 号
note_en: 48 Doughty Street

name: Sherlock Holmes Museum
note: 贝克街 221B 门牌
note_en: It carries the 221B Baker Street door number

name: Xu Zhimo poem stone, King's College
name_zh: 国王学院 · 徐志摩诗碑
note: 刻有《再别康桥》诗句的石碑
note_en: A stone carved with lines from Saying Goodbye to Cambridge Again

name: Lao She blue plaque, St James's Gardens
name_zh: 圣詹姆斯花园路 · 老舍故居蓝牌
note: 2003 年英国遗产委员会设立
note_en: Put up by English Heritage in 2003

name: Coastguard Cottages, Cuckmere Haven
name_zh: Cuckmere Haven · 海岸警卫队小屋（七姐妹白崖）
scene: 结局里 Robbie 与 Cecilia 的海边小屋
scene_en: Robbie and Cecilia's seaside cottage in the ending

name: Leadenhall Market
scene: 对角巷与破釜酒吧入口
scene_en: Diagon Alley and the entrance to the Leaky Cauldron

name: Christ Church, Oxford
name_zh: 牛津 · 基督教堂学院
scene: 新生走进霍格沃茨礼堂的楼梯
scene_en: The staircase where first-years walk up to the Great Hall

name: Alnwick Castle
scene: 霍格沃茨外景与飞行课
scene_en: Hogwarts exteriors and the flying lesson

name: Glenfinnan Viaduct
scene: 霍格沃茨特快列车
scene_en: The Hogwarts Express crossing the viaduct

name: Dyrham Park
scene: Darlington Hall 外景与车道
scene_en: Darlington Hall's exterior and drive

name: Chalcot Crescent, Primrose Hill
scene: 布朗一家 Windsor Gardens 32 号外景
scene_en: The Browns' house at 32 Windsor Gardens
coord_checked: Numbers 24-46 and attached railings, Chalcot Crescent — https://historicengland.org.uk/listing/the-list/list-entry/1244108

name: Doune Castle
scene: 麦肯齐家族的 Castle Leoch
scene_en: Castle Leoch, seat of Clan MacKenzie

name: Lindisfarne (Holy Island)
note: 诺森伯兰海外的潮汐岛，每天两次被潮水隔断；圣艾丹于 635 年在岛上建立修道院
note_en: A tidal island off Northumberland, cut off by the sea twice a day; St Aidan founded its monastery in 635

name: Bamburgh Castle
note: 诺森伯兰海岸高岩上的城堡
note_en: A castle on a high rock above the Northumberland coast

name: Glencoyne Bay, Ullswater
name_zh: 阿尔斯沃特湖 · 格伦科因湾
prototype_of: 诗中没有点名：1802 年 4 月 15 日华兹华斯兄妹在这段湖岸看见成片的水仙，多萝西的日记记下了这一天，两年后华兹华斯写成这首诗
prototype_of_en: Not named in the poem: William and Dorothy Wordsworth saw the daffodils on this shore on 15 April 1802, as Dorothy's journal records; he wrote the poem two years later

name: Manchester
prototype_of: 《南方与北方》里的工业城 Milton 的原型
prototype_of_en: The model for Milton, the mill town of North and South

name: Erewash valley near Cossall
name_zh: 埃瑞瓦什河谷 · 科索尔附近
note: 诺丁汉郡与德比郡交界处埃瑞瓦什河的河谷，劳伦斯的家乡一带
note_en: The valley of the River Erewash on the Nottinghamshire–Derbyshire border, Lawrence's home country
coord_checked: Cossall (Wikipedia, via wikwiand mirror; also List of UK locations Cos-Cou) — https://wikwiand-revamp.pages.dev/en/Cossall

name: Bredon Hill
note: 伍斯特郡一座孤立的山，属科茨沃尔德丘陵的外围
note_en: A lone hill in Worcestershire, an outlier of the Cotswolds

name: Wenlock Edge
note: 什罗普郡一道长长的、长满树林的石灰岩陡崖
note_en: A long wooded limestone escarpment in Shropshire

name: Clun
note: 什罗普郡西南、靠近威尔士边境的小镇，有一座城堡废墟
note_en: A small town in south-west Shropshire near the Welsh border, with a ruined castle

name: Ludlow
note: 什罗普郡南部的集镇。弥尔顿的假面剧《科摩斯》1634 年在拉德洛城堡首演；豪斯曼的骨灰葬在镇上的圣劳伦斯教堂
note_en: A market town in south Shropshire. Milton's masque Comus was first performed at Ludlow Castle in 1634, and Housman's ashes are buried at the town's church, St Laurence's

name: Giant's Causeway
note: 安特里姆郡海岸约四万根相互咬合的玄武岩石柱，世界遗产
note_en: About 40,000 interlocking basalt columns on the County Antrim coast, a World Heritage Site

name: Belfast
note: 北爱尔兰首府，位于拉根河注入贝尔法斯特湾的地方
note_en: The capital of Northern Ireland, on the River Lagan at the head of Belfast Lough

name: Chatsworth House
prototype_of: 常被认为是《傲慢与偏见》彭伯里庄园的原型
prototype_of_en: Widely held to be a model for Pemberley in Pride and Prejudice

name: Brighton
note: 萨塞克斯海边的度假城，因摄政王而成为时髦去处
note_en: The Sussex seaside town made fashionable by the Prince Regent

name: Box Hill
note: 萨里郡北丘陵上的白垩山，向南视野开阔
note_en: A chalk hill on the North Downs in Surrey, with wide views to the south

name: Bath
note: 萨默塞特郡的乔治王时代温泉城，围绕罗马时代的温泉兴建
note_en: The Georgian spa city in Somerset, built around the Roman hot springs

name: Beechen Cliff, Bath
note: 巴斯南边一座陡峭的林木山丘，可以俯瞰全城
note_en: A steep wooded hill south of Bath, with a view over the city
coord_checked: Beechen Cliff, Bath and North East Somerset — https://britishplacenames.uk/beechen-cliff-bath-and-north-east-somerset-st748640/maps

name: The Pump Room, Bath
note: 罗马浴场旁的乔治王时代大厅，访客来这里喝温泉水
note_en: The Georgian hall next to the Roman Baths, where visitors came to drink the spa water

name: Rochester Castle
note: 肯特郡梅德韦河畔的诺曼主堡，是英格兰最高的主堡
note_en: A Norman keep on the River Medway in Kent, the tallest keep in England

name: Great Yarmouth
note: 诺福克郡的港口和海滨小城，位于耶尔河与北海之间的沙嘴上
note_en: A Norfolk port and seaside town on a spit between the River Yare and the North Sea

name: Preston
prototype_of: 常被认为是《艰难时世》焦煤镇的原型
prototype_of_en: Often named as the model for Coketown in Hard Times

name: St James' Church, Cooling
name_zh: 库林 · 圣詹姆斯教堂
prototype_of: 《远大前程》开篇沼地墓园的原型
prototype_of_en: The model for the marsh churchyard where Great Expectations opens

name: Knutsford
prototype_of: 《克兰福德》的原型，盖斯凯尔在这里长大
prototype_of_en: The model for Cranford, where Gaskell grew up

name: Gainsborough
prototype_of: 《弗洛斯河上的磨坊》圣奥格镇的原型
prototype_of_en: The model for St Ogg's in The Mill on the Floss

name: Blackmore Vale
note: 多塞特北部宽阔的黏土谷地，哈代称它为“小牛奶场谷”
note_en: A wide clay vale in north Dorset, which Hardy calls the Vale of the Little Dairies

name: Stonehenge
note: 索尔兹伯里平原上的史前巨石阵，始建于约公元前 3000 年
note_en: The prehistoric stone circle on Salisbury Plain, begun around 3000 BC

name: Dartmoor
note: 德文郡的花岗岩高沼地，现为国家公园
note_en: A granite moorland in Devon, now a national park

name: Erraid
note: 马尔岛罗斯半岛外的小潮汐岛；史蒂文森家族的公司修建杜阿塔赫灯塔时，在岛上设过工地
note_en: A small tidal island off the Ross of Mull, where the Stevenson family firm had its shore base while building the Dubh Artach lighthouse

name: South Queensferry
note: 福斯湾南岸的小镇，就在福斯桥脚下
note_en: A town on the south shore of the Firth of Forth, beneath the Forth Bridge

name: Hampton Court maze
note: 汉普顿宫花园里的树篱迷宫，17 世纪 90 年代种下
note_en: The hedge maze in the gardens of Hampton Court Palace, planted in the 1690s

name: Marlow
note: 白金汉郡泰晤士河畔的小镇，有一座 1830 年代的吊桥
note_en: A Buckinghamshire town on the Thames, with a suspension bridge from the 1830s

name: Iffley Lock
note: 牛津下游不远处泰晤士河上的船闸
note_en: A lock on the Thames just below Oxford

name: Eastwood
prototype_of: 劳伦斯的出生地，《儿子与情人》里 Bestwood 的原型
prototype_of_en: Lawrence's birthplace, the model for Bestwood in Sons and Lovers

name: Sherwood Forest
note: 诺丁汉郡王家森林留下的部分，现在是以“大橡树”为中心的郊野公园
note_en: What is left of the royal forest in Nottinghamshire, now a country park around the Major Oak

name: Iona
note: 马尔岛外的小岛，圣科伦巴于 563 年在这里建立修道院
note_en: A small island off Mull where St Columba founded a monastery in 563

name: Loch Ness
note: 因弗内斯西南大峡谷中狭长幽深的淡水湖
note_en: A long, deep freshwater loch in the Great Glen, south-west of Inverness

name: Shakespeare Cliff, Dover
name_zh: 多佛尔 · 莎士比亚崖
note: 多佛尔西边的白垩崖，因《李尔王》中的悬崖一场而得名
note_en: A chalk cliff west of Dover, named after the cliff scene in King Lear

name: Dover
note: 肯特郡的港口，隔英吉利海峡最窄处与法国相望
note_en: The Kent port facing France across the narrowest part of the Channel

name: Grantchester
note: 剑桥以南约两英里康河边的村庄
note_en: A village on the Cam about two miles south of Cambridge

name: Loch Katrine
note: 特罗萨克斯的湖，司各特的这首诗使它成了游览胜地
note_en: A loch in the Trossachs that Scott's poem turned into a place for tourists

name: Oxford
note: 泰晤士河与查韦尔河畔的大学城
note_en: The university city on the Thames and the Cherwell

name: Elwy valley
note: 北威尔士埃尔威河的河谷，离霍普金斯修习耶稣会神学的圣伯诺学院不远
note_en: The valley of the River Elwy in north Wales, near St Beuno's, where Hopkins studied as a Jesuit

name: Burslem
prototype_of: 本涅特《老妇谭》里 Bursley 的原型
prototype_of_en: The model for Bursley in The Old Wives' Tale

name: Bateman's and Pook's Hill, Burwash
name_zh: 伯沃什 · 贝特曼斯与普克山
note: 吉卜林在东萨塞克斯伯沃什的住宅贝特曼斯；普克山就是小河达德韦尔对岸那片长满树林的山坡
note_en: Bateman's, Kipling's house at Burwash in East Sussex; Pook's Hill is the wooded slope across the little River Dudwell

name: Snowdon
note: 海拔 1085 米，威尔士最高峰，威尔士语名 Yr Wyddfa
note_en: At 1,085 m the highest mountain in Wales, Yr Wyddfa in Welsh

name: Llangollen
note: 威尔士东北部迪河畔的小镇
note_en: A town on the River Dee in north-east Wales

name: Doone Valley, Badgworthy Water
name_zh: 杜恩谷 · 巴奇沃西溪
note: 埃克斯穆尔高沼上巴奇沃西溪的一条支谷，位于德文郡和萨默塞特郡交界
note_en: A side valley of Badgworthy Water on Exmoor, on the Devon–Somerset border
coord_checked: MDE1258 - Deserted medieval settlement at Badgworthy Water - Exmoor HER — https://www.exmoorher.co.uk/Monument/MDE1258

name: Norham Castle
note: 特威德河英格兰一岸的边境城堡遗址
note_en: A ruined border castle on the English bank of the Tweed

name: Hadrian's Wall at Housesteads
name_zh: 哈德良长城 · 豪斯斯特兹
note: 哈德良长城上保存最好的罗马要塞，在诺森伯兰
note_en: The best-preserved Roman fort on Hadrian's Wall, in Northumberland

name: Tynemouth Priory
note: 泰恩河口岬角上的修道院和城堡遗址
note_en: A ruined priory and castle on the headland at the mouth of the Tyne

name: Corrymellagh (Corrymeela), near Cushendun
name_zh: 库申登附近 · 科里米拉（Corrymellagh）
note: 唯一叫这个名字的小地块，也拼作 Corrymeela，就在莫伊拉·奥尼尔长大的库申登附近；诗里没有说明指哪里，这是最可能的解读，并非定论
note_en: The only townland of this name, also spelt Corrymeela, near Cushendun where Moira O'Neill grew up; the poem does not say which place it means, so this is the likeliest reading, not a certainty
coord_checked: Corrymellagh townland, Culfeightrin parish (gazetteer.org.uk GBPN326462, Irish grid D 2542 3518; same point on townlands.ie) — https://gazetteer.org.uk/place/Corrymellagh_TD,_Antrim_326462

note: 伍尔夫和丈夫伦纳德 1919 年买下的乡间小屋，1940 年起长住；她的许多小说是在花园尽头的写作小屋里成形的。她去世后，伦纳德把她的骨灰葬在花园的榆树下。1980 年起由国民信托作为作家故居开放参观
note_en: The cottage Virginia and Leonard Woolf bought in 1919 and lived in full-time from 1940; many of her novels took shape in the writing lodge at the end of the garden. Leonard buried her ashes under an elm in the garden. The National Trust has run it as a writer's house museum since 1980
coord_checked: Monk's House, Rodmell (Geograph photo 3940379, subject location; Wikipedia gives 50.8387, 0.0165) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/3940379

name: Christ Church, Lewis Carroll's college
name_zh: 牛津 · 卡罗尔任教的基督教堂学院
note: 卡罗尔 1851 年进入基督教堂学院读书，之后留在学院，1855 至 1881 年担任数学讲师；爱丽丝·利德尔是院长亨利·利德尔的女儿。标记放在学院的大方庭汤姆方庭
note_en: Carroll came up to Christ Church in 1851 and stayed on as a Student of the college, teaching mathematics from 1855 to 1881; Alice Liddell was a daughter of the Dean, Henry Liddell. The marker is in Tom Quad, the great quadrangle
coord_checked: Mercury fountain at the centre of Tom Quad (Geograph photo 187947, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/187947

name: Alice's Shop, St Aldate's
name_zh: 圣奥尔代茨街 · 爱丽丝小店
prototype_of: 《爱丽丝镜中奇遇》第 5 章老羊开的那家小店的原型，坦尼尔的插图画的就是这家店。对面基督教堂学院院长的女儿爱丽丝·利德尔当年常来这里买糖；现在是一家卖爱丽丝纪念品的小店
prototype_of_en: The model for the Old Sheep Shop in chapter 5 of Through the Looking-Glass; Tenniel's illustration shows this shop. Alice Liddell, the Dean's daughter from Christ Church across the road, used to buy sweets here; it now sells Alice gifts
coord_checked: Alice's Shop, 83 St Aldate's (Geograph photo 8084523, subject location SP 51410 05841) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/8084523

name: Talland House, St Ives
name_zh: 圣艾夫斯 · 塔兰德宅
note: 莱斯利·斯蒂芬租下的海边别墅，俯瞰波斯明斯特湾，对岸就是戈德雷维灯塔。伍尔夫出生后的头 13 年，全家每年夏天都在这里住三个月；1894 年以后再没回来。这些夏天后来写进了《到灯塔去》
note_en: The house above Porthminster Bay that Leslie Stephen rented for the family's summers, with Godrevy Lighthouse across the bay. Virginia spent three months here every summer for the first 13 years of her life; the family did not come back after 1894. Those summers lie behind To the Lighthouse
coord_checked: Talland House (Commons photo 'Talland House, St Ives, Cornwall - May 2022', camera location 50.20842, -5.47912) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Talland_House,_St_Ives,_Cornwall_-_May_2022.jpg

name: 46 Gordon Square, Bloomsbury
name_zh: 布卢姆斯伯里 · 戈登广场 46 号
note: 1904 年父亲去世后，斯蒂芬家的兄妹从肯辛顿搬进这栋房子。弗吉尼亚和姐姐瓦妮莎在这里办“周四晚会”，招待哥哥索比的剑桥朋友，这里成了布卢姆斯伯里文化圈最早的聚会地。瓦妮莎结婚后，弗吉尼亚搬去了菲茨罗伊广场；后来凯恩斯住在这里
note_en: After their father's death in 1904 the Stephen siblings left Kensington for this house; the Thursday Evenings that Virginia and Vanessa held here for Thoby's Cambridge friends made it the first centre of the Bloomsbury Group. Virginia moved to Fitzroy Square after Vanessa married; Keynes later lived here
coord_checked: 46 Gordon Square (Commons photo '46 Gordon Square Bloomsbury Camden London, WC1H 0PD', taken in front of the house, camera location 51.52442, -0.13018) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:46_Gordon_Square_Bloomsbury_Camden_London,_WC1H_0PD.jpg

name: Hogarth House, Richmond
note: 伍尔夫夫妇 1915 至 1924 年住在这里；1917 年在餐厅的桌子上办起了出版社，以这座房子命名为霍加斯出版社。门口的蓝牌记着这两件事
note_en: Leonard and Virginia Woolf lived here from 1915 to 1924, and in 1917 set up the Hogarth Press on the dining-room table, naming it after the house; a blue plaque records both
coord_checked: Hogarth House, 34 Paradise Road (English Heritage blue plaques); position from the Commons photo 'LEONARD and VIRGINIA WOOLF - Hogarth House 34 Paradise Road Richmond TW9 1SE', camera location 51.460448, -0.300786 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:LEONARD_and_VIRGINIA_WOOLF_-_Hogarth_House_34_Paradise_Road_Richmond_TW9_1SE.jpg

name: Godrevy Lighthouse
prototype_of: 圣艾夫斯湾小岛上的灯塔，斯蒂芬家的孩子们在塔兰德宅就能望见它。小说把拉姆齐一家搬到了斯凯岛，但书里的灯塔通常被认为来自戈德雷维
prototype_of_en: The lighthouse on its rock in St Ives Bay that the Stephen children looked out to from Talland House. The novel moves the Ramsays to the Isle of Skye, but its lighthouse is usually traced to Godrevy
coord_checked: Godrevy Lighthouse, Godrevy Island (Geograph photo 407138, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/407138

name: Senate House, University of London
name_zh: 伦敦大学 · 参议院大楼
prototype_of: 常被认为是“真理部”的原型：二战期间这里是英国新闻部所在地，奥威尔的妻子艾琳就在新闻部的审查处工作。这座装饰艺术风格的大楼建于 1932 至 1937 年
prototype_of_en: Usually taken as the model for the Ministry of Truth: in the Second World War it housed the Ministry of Information, where Orwell's wife Eileen worked in the Censorship Department. The Art Deco tower was built in 1932–37
coord_checked: Senate House (Geograph photo 2855085, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/2855085

name: Barnhill, Isle of Jura
name_zh: 朱拉岛 · 巴恩希尔农舍
note: 朱拉岛北部的农舍，奥威尔 1946 年至 1949 年 1 月断断续续住在这里，在这里写完了《一九八四》。现在仍作度假屋出租，屋子基本保持他住时的样子
note_en: The farmhouse in the north of Jura where Orwell lived on and off from 1946 to January 1949 and finished Nineteen Eighty-Four. It is still let to holidaymakers, much as he left it

name: George Orwell's grave, Sutton Courtenay
name_zh: 萨顿考特尼 · 奥威尔墓
note: 奥威尔以本名埃里克·亚瑟·布莱尔葬在诸圣堂的墓园。他希望葬在英格兰乡间的教堂墓地，大卫·阿斯特的家族是这里的庄园主，由他安排了这块墓地
note_en: Orwell lies in All Saints' churchyard under his real name, Eric Arthur Blair. He wanted to be buried in an English country churchyard, and David Astor, whose family owned the manor, arranged a place here
coord_checked: Graves of Astor and Orwell, All Saints, Sutton Courtenay (Geograph photo 362296, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/362296

name: Wallington, Hertfordshire
name_zh: 赫特福德郡 · 沃灵顿村
prototype_of: 奥威尔 1936 至 1940 年住在村里基茨巷 2 号的“杂货铺”，开小店、养山羊，也在村里的教堂和艾琳结婚。村里的庄园农场和大谷仓被认为是《动物农场》里那座农场的原型
prototype_of_en: Orwell lived at The Stores, 2 Kits Lane, from 1936 to 1940, keeping a small shop and goats, and married Eileen in the parish church; the village's Manor Farm and Great Barn are taken as the models for the farm in Animal Farm
coord_checked: George Orwell's plaque, Wallington (Geograph photo 6849927, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/6849927

name: Barnet
note: 伦敦北缘大北路上的老集镇，奥利弗步行去伦敦，在这里遇见了“机灵鬼”
note_en: The old market town on the Great North Road at London's northern edge, where Oliver, walking to London, meets the Artful Dodger
coord_checked: Barnet High Street (Geograph photo 369802, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/369802

name: Cornhill
note: 伦敦城的一条街，靠近英格兰银行，也就是斯克鲁奇账房所在的一带
note_en: A street in the City of London, near the Bank of England and Scrooge's counting-house
coord_checked: St Peter upon Cornhill, Cornhill (Geograph photo 1767459, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/1767459

name: Orkney
note: 苏格兰北岸外的群岛，维克多·弗兰肯斯坦选了其中最偏远的一个小岛。标记放在主城柯克沃尔
note_en: The islands off the north coast of Scotland; Victor Frankenstein chooses one of the remotest of them. The marker is at Kirkwall, the main town
coord_checked: Kirkwall, Orkney Mainland (Geograph photo 5726878, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/5726878

name: Exeter
note: 德文郡的大教堂城市；达什伍德一家住的巴顿小屋就在城北四英里
note_en: The cathedral city of Devon; the Dashwoods' Barton Cottage lies four miles north of it
coord_checked: Exeter Cathedral (Commons photo 'Exeter (Devon, UK), Cathedral Church of Saint Peter -- 2013 -- 1417', object location) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Exeter_(Devon,_UK),_Cathedral_Church_of_Saint_Peter_--_2013_--_1417.jpg

name: Bristol harbour
note: 布里斯托尔市中心的港口，乡绅在这里给“伊斯班袅拉号”装备出海
note_en: The docks in the heart of Bristol, where the squire fits out the Hispaniola for Treasure Island
coord_checked: Floating Harbour, Bristol (Geograph photo 1858154, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/1858154

name: Portland Place
note: 马里波恩区的一条宽街，理查德·汉内租的公寓就在附近，故事从这里开始
note_en: A broad street in Marylebone; Richard Hannay has a flat near it, where the story begins
coord_checked: Portland Place, Central London (Geograph photo 4675256, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/4675256

name: York
note: 约克郡有城墙的大教堂城市，鲁滨逊 1632 年生在这里
note_en: The walled cathedral city of Yorkshire, where Robinson Crusoe is born in 1632
coord_checked: York Minster (Commons photo 'York Minster Nave 2, Nth Yorkshire, UK - Diliff', camera location) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:York_Minster_Nave_2,_Nth_Yorkshire,_UK_-_Diliff.jpg

name: Emmanuel College, Cambridge
name_zh: 剑桥 · 伊曼纽尔学院
note: 剑桥的一所学院，1584 年创办；格列佛十四岁进这里读了三年书
note_en: A Cambridge college founded in 1584, where Gulliver studies for three years from the age of fourteen
coord_checked: Emmanuel College (Commons photo 'Emmanuel College Front Court, Cambridge, UK - Diliff', camera location) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Emmanuel_College_Front_Court,_Cambridge,_UK_-_Diliff.jpg

name: Coventry
prototype_of: 很可能是米德尔马契的原型：乔治·艾略特去伦敦之前住在考文垂，这里和米德尔马契一样以丝带业为生
prototype_of_en: Probably the model for Middlemarch: George Eliot lived in Coventry before moving to London, and like Middlemarch it was a silk-ribbon town
coord_checked: Two spires, Coventry (Geograph photo 1065743, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/1065743

name: Dorchester
prototype_of: 哈代的家乡小城，在他的小说里叫卡斯特桥
prototype_of_en: Hardy's home town, called Casterbridge in his novels
coord_checked: Dorchester, View of High West Street (Geograph photo 1834521, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/1834521

name: Great Maytham Hall, Rolvenden
name_zh: 罗尔文登 · 大梅瑟姆庄园
prototype_of: 伯内特 1898 至 1907 年住在这里，发现庄园里建于 1721 年的围墙花园荒废多年、杂草丛生；《秘密花园》就由此而来
prototype_of_en: Burnett lived here from 1898 to 1907 and found its walled garden of 1721 overgrown and neglected; it inspired The Secret Garden
coord_checked: Great Maytham Hall Garden (Geograph photo 228928, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/228928

name: Poohsticks Bridge, Ashdown Forest
name_zh: 阿什当森林 · 噗噗棍桥
prototype_of: 米尔恩常带儿子克里斯托弗·罗宾在阿什当森林散步，这里就是故事里的森林，林中的“五百英亩林”就是“百亩林”。标记放在森林外缘哈特菲尔德附近的噗噗棍桥，米尔恩家的乡间住所科奇福德农场就在旁边
prototype_of_en: Ashdown Forest, where Milne walked with his son Christopher Robin, is the Forest of the stories, and its Five Hundred Acre Wood the Hundred Acre Wood. The marker is at Poohsticks Bridge, just outside the forest near Hartfield, where the Milnes had their country home at Cotchford Farm
coord_checked: Poohsticks Bridge (Geograph photo 3937589, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/3937589

name: Menabilly and Polridmouth, near Fowey
name_zh: 福伊附近 · 梅纳比利
prototype_of: 杜穆里埃少女时代发现了这座藏在林中的宅子，后来在这里一直住到 1969 年；它和剑桥郡的米尔顿庄园一起成了曼陀丽的原型——曼陀丽也像它一样藏在树林里，从海边看不见。宅子是私产，照片拍的是宅子下面的波利德茅斯小海湾
prototype_of_en: Du Maurier discovered this hidden house as a teenager and later lived in it until 1969; with Milton Hall in Cambridgeshire it was the model for Manderley, which like Menabilly lay hidden in woods out of sight of the shore. The house is private; the photo shows Polridmouth cove below it

name: Sarehole Mill, Birmingham
name_zh: 伯明翰 · 萨尔霍尔磨坊
prototype_of: 托尔金小时候就住在这座水磨坊几百码外，他说霍比屯的磨坊就是照它写的；他把这一带的乡野称作“一种失落的乐园”
prototype_of_en: Tolkien lived within a few hundred yards of this watermill as a small boy, and said he used it as the model for the Mill at Hobbiton; he called the countryside around it 'a kind of lost paradise'

name: Rostrevor and Carlingford Lough
name_zh: 罗斯特雷沃与卡林福德湾
prototype_of: 刘易斯在给哥哥的信里写道，罗斯特雷沃俯瞰卡林福德湾的那一带，就是他心中的纳尼亚；他在贝尔法斯特长大，也提到过这里背后的莫恩山
prototype_of_en: Lewis wrote to his brother that the part of Rostrevor overlooking Carlingford Lough was his idea of Narnia; he grew up in Belfast and also named the Mourne Mountains above it
coord_checked: Rostrevor and Carlingford Lough (Geograph photo 687576, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/687576

name: Hill Top, Near Sawrey
note: 比阿特丽克斯·波特 1905 年买下的农舍；她把它留给了国民信托，现在作为作家故居开放
note_en: The farmhouse Beatrix Potter bought in 1905 with the money from her first books, Peter Rabbit among them; she left it to the National Trust, which opens it as a writer's house

name: Burns Cottage, Alloway
note: 彭斯的父亲 1757 年盖的茅草屋。罗伯特 1759 年 1 月 25 日生在这里，住到七岁左右；现在是苏格兰国民信托管理的罗伯特·彭斯出生地博物馆的一部分
note_en: The thatched cottage Burns's father built in 1757. Robert was born here on 25 January 1759 and lived here until he was about seven; it is now part of the Robert Burns Birthplace Museum, run by the National Trust for Scotland
coord_checked: Burns Cottage, Alloway (Geograph photo 428032, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/428032

name: The Writers' Museum, Lady Stair's House
name_zh: 爱丁堡 · 作家博物馆（莱迪·斯泰尔宅）
note: 皇家一英里上端劳恩市场旁小巷里的莱迪·斯泰尔宅，现在是作家博物馆，专门介绍苏格兰三位大作家彭斯、司各特和史蒂文森的生平
note_en: A museum in Lady Stair's House, in a close off the Lawnmarket at the top of the Royal Mile, given to the lives of Scotland's three great writers: Robert Burns, Walter Scott and Robert Louis Stevenson
coord_checked: Lady Stair's House (Geograph photo 2140534, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/2140534

name: Elizabeth Gaskell's House, Manchester
name_zh: 曼彻斯特 · 盖斯凯尔故居
note: 盖斯凯尔一家 1850 年搬进普利茅斯林荫路 84 号，她后来的书，包括《克兰福德》和《南方与北方》，都是在这里写的；夏洛蒂·勃朗特来住过三次，狄更斯也来拜访过。2014 年修复后对外开放
note_en: The Gaskells moved into 84 Plymouth Grove in 1850, and Elizabeth wrote all her later books here, Cranford and North and South among them; Charlotte Brontë stayed three times and Dickens called. Restored and opened to visitors in 2014
coord_checked: Elizabeth Gaskell's House, Plymouth Grove (Geograph photo 720377, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/720377

name: D. H. Lawrence Birthplace Museum, Eastwood
name_zh: 伊斯特伍德 · D. H. 劳伦斯出生地博物馆
note: 维多利亚街 8a 号的矿工住宅，劳伦斯 1885 年生在这里；屋子按当年一家人住时的样子布置，还陈列着他最初的墓碑
note_en: The miner's house at 8a Victoria Street where Lawrence was born in 1885, kept as it is thought to have been when the family lived there; his original gravestone is on show
coord_checked: D H Lawrence Birthplace Museum, Eastwood (Geograph photo 7641153, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/7641153

name: George Eliot's grave, Highgate Cemetery
name_zh: 海格特公墓 · 乔治·艾略特墓
note: 墓碑上刻着她的笔名，以及婚后的名字玛丽·安·克罗斯；她葬在伴侣乔治·亨利·刘易斯的旁边
note_en: The headstone gives her pen name and her married name, Mary Ann Cross; she lies next to George Henry Lewes, her partner
coord_checked: The grave of George Eliot in Highgate Cemetery (Geograph photo 5876589, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/5876589

name: Reading Gaol
note: 王尔德 1895 至 1897 年被关在这里；1896 年狱中的一次绞刑，后来写成了《雷丁监狱之歌》。监狱 2014 年关闭
note_en: Oscar Wilde was held here from 1895 to 1897; an execution at the prison in 1896 lies behind The Ballad of Reading Gaol. The prison closed in 2014
coord_checked: Reading Prison (Geograph photo 5320123, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/5320123

name: J. R. R. Tolkien's grave, Wolvercote Cemetery
name_zh: 牛津沃尔弗科特公墓 · 托尔金墓
note: 托尔金 1973 年去世，和妻子伊迪丝合葬；墓碑上还刻着他传说里那对恋人的名字：贝伦和露西恩
note_en: Tolkien, who died in 1973, is buried with his wife Edith; the stone gives them the names of the lovers in his legends, Beren and Lúthien
coord_checked: Grave of Edith and J.R.R. Tolkien (Commons photo, camera location at the grave) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Grave_of_Edith_and_J.R.R._Tolkien_in_the_Wolvercote_Cemetery,_Oxonmoot_1979.jpg

name: The Kilns, Headington
note: 刘易斯 1930 年和哥哥沃伦、简妮·摩尔一起买下这座房子，此后一直住在这里，纳尼亚系列也是在这里写的；现在是 C. S. 刘易斯基金会的研究中心
note_en: Lewis bought the house in 1930 with his brother Warren and Janie Moore, and lived here for the rest of his life, writing the Narnia books here; it is now a study centre run by the C. S. Lewis Foundation
coord_checked: The Kilns, home of C.S. Lewis (Geograph photo 7925307, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/7925307

name: Bunhill Fields
note: 1665 至 1854 年间不信国教者的墓地，现在是公共花园。布莱克、笛福和班扬都葬在这里：笛福的方尖碑立于 1870 年，班扬的墓上有他的卧像，标出布莱克墓穴位置的石碑 2018 年揭幕
note_en: A burial ground for nonconformists from 1665 to 1854, now a public garden. William Blake, Daniel Defoe and John Bunyan lie here: Defoe's obelisk went up in 1870, Bunyan's tomb carries his effigy, and a stone marking Blake's grave was unveiled in 2018
coord_checked: Defoe and Blake memorials, Bunhill Fields (Geograph photo 3710090, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/3710090

name: St Olave's Church, Hart Street
name_zh: 哈特街 · 圣奥拉夫教堂
note: 佩皮斯所属的教区教堂，日记里称它“我们自己的教堂”。他在这里修了一条从海军部直通的楼廊，1669 年妻子伊丽莎白去世后在这里立了她的胸像，1703 年葬在她身旁
note_en: Pepys's parish church, 'our own church' in the diary. He had a gallery built here reached from the Navy Office, put up a bust of his wife Elizabeth after her death in 1669, and was buried beside her in 1703
coord_checked: St Olave, Hart Street (Geograph photo 1085120, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/1085120

name: Mary Shelley's grave, Bournemouth
name_zh: 伯恩茅斯 · 玛丽·雪莱墓
note: 玛丽·雪莱葬在圣彼得教堂的墓园，据说和珀西·比希·雪莱的心脏葬在一起；她的儿子把她的父母玛丽·沃斯通克拉夫特和威廉·葛德文也迁葬到这里
note_en: Mary Shelley lies in St Peter's churchyard, reputedly with the heart of Percy Bysshe Shelley; her son had her parents, Mary Wollstonecraft and William Godwin, reburied here beside her
coord_checked: Grave of Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley (Geograph photo 1861397, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/1861397

name: Newstead Abbey
note: 拜伦家族的祖宅。1798 年他十岁时连同爵位一起继承下来，1808 年起断断续续住过几段时间，1818 年人在意大利时把它卖掉。《唐璜》第十三到十六章里的诺曼修道院就是照它写的。现在归诺丁汉市政府所有，对外开放，里面有拜伦博物馆
note_en: Byron's family seat. He inherited it with the title in 1798, aged ten, lived here for short spells from 1808, and sold it in 1818 while he was in Italy. The Norman Abbey of Don Juan, Cantos 13 to 16, is drawn from it. It now belongs to Nottingham City Council and is open to visitors, with a Byron museum inside

name: Byron's grave, Hucknall
note: 拜伦 1824 年死在希腊的迈索隆吉翁。威斯敏斯特教堂拒绝让他入葬，他被葬进这座圣玛利亚·抹大拉教堂里的拜伦家族墓穴。墓上那块大理石板是希腊国王送的，他的女儿艾达·洛芙莱斯后来也葬在他身旁。威斯敏斯特教堂直到 1969 年才为他立了纪念碑
note_en: Byron died at Missolonghi in Greece in 1824. Westminster Abbey refused to bury him, and he was laid in the Byron family vault in St Mary Magdalene's. A marble slab given by the King of Greece lies above the grave, and his daughter Ada Lovelace was later buried beside him. Westminster Abbey put up a memorial to him in 1969
coord_checked: Church of St Mary Magdalene, Hucknall (Wikipedia) — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Church_of_St_Mary_Magdalene,_Hucknall

name: St Mary's churchyard, Harrow on the Hill
name_zh: 哈罗山 · 圣玛利亚教堂墓园
note: 拜伦 1801 至 1805 年在哈罗公学读书，常坐在这里的皮奇墓旁发呆，说它是“我最喜欢的墓碑”。诗里那棵榆树 1935 年以前就烧毁了；墓前有一块 1905 年立的石碑，刻着这首诗。他的女儿阿莱格拉葬在教堂南门廊旁，墓上没有标记
note_en: As a boy at Harrow School, from 1801 to 1805, Byron liked to sit and daydream by the Peachey Tomb here, his 'favourite tombstone'. The elm of the poem burnt down before 1935; a stone put up in front of the tomb in 1905 carries the poem. His daughter Allegra lies in an unmarked grave by the south porch
coord_checked: The Peachey tomb in St Mary's Churchyard, Harrow on the Hill (Geograph photo by Marathon, Commons object location) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Peachey_tomb_in_St_Mary%27s_Churchyard,_Harrow_on_the_Hill_-_geograph.org.uk_-_4730479.jpg

name: Lochnagar
note: 凯恩戈姆山区巴尔莫勒尔庄园里的一座山，海拔 1155 米。拜伦童年有一段时间住在阿伯丁郡，他在这首诗的注里说，自己小时候就住在这座山附近。标记放在山顶
note_en: A 1,155-metre mountain on the Balmoral estate in the Cairngorms. Byron spent part of his childhood in Aberdeenshire, and in his note to the poem says he lived near it in his early years. The marker is at the summit

name: Shelley Memorial, University College, Oxford
name_zh: 牛津大学学院 · 雪莱纪念像
note: 雪莱 1810 年进大学学院，1811 年 3 月 25 日因为小册子《无神论的必要性》和朋友霍格一起被开除。现在学院以他为荣：爱德华·昂斯洛·福特雕的溺水诗人大理石像，原本打算放在他罗马的墓地，1893 年起安放在高街边一间带穹顶的小屋里
note_en: Shelley came up to University College in 1810 and was expelled on 25 March 1811, with his friend Thomas Jefferson Hogg, over the pamphlet The Necessity of Atheism. The college now honours him: Edward Onslow Ford's marble figure of the drowned poet, first meant for his grave in Rome, has stood in a domed room off the High Street since 1893

name: Albion House, Marlow
note: 雪莱一家 1817 年 3 月到 1818 年 2 月住在西街 104 号的阿尔比恩宅。珀西在马洛附近的树林里写了长诗《莱昂与茜丝娜》（后改名《伊斯兰的起义》），玛丽在这里写完了《弗兰肯斯坦》。房子现在叫雪莱小屋，是私宅，门外有纪念牌
note_en: The Shelleys lived at Albion House, 104 West Street, from March 1817 to February 1818. Percy wrote Laon and Cythna, reissued as The Revolt of Islam, in the woods near Marlow, and Mary finished Frankenstein here. The house is now private, as Shelley Cottages, with a plaque outside
coord_checked: Albion House / Shelley Cottage, Marlow (British Listed Buildings, Grade II) — https://britishlistedbuildings.co.uk/101217597-albion-houseshelley-cottageshelley-house-marlow

name: St Peter's Field (Peterloo), Manchester
name_zh: 曼彻斯特 · 圣彼得广场（彼得卢）
note: 1819 年 8 月 16 日，数万人聚集在圣彼得广场要求议会改革，骑兵冲进人群，造成 18 人死亡、数百人受伤。雪莱当时在意大利，9 月才得到消息，写下《暴政的假面游行》，副标题是“为曼彻斯特屠杀而作”，直到 1832 年才出版。这片空地现在是圣彼得广场，2019 年杰里米·德勒设计的彼得卢纪念碑在旁边落成。标记放在纪念碑处
note_en: On 16 August 1819 cavalry charged a crowd of tens of thousands gathered on St Peter's Field to call for parliamentary reform; eighteen people were killed and hundreds injured. Shelley, in Italy, heard the news in September and wrote The Mask of Anarchy, 'written on the occasion of the massacre at Manchester'; it was not published until 1832. The field is now St Peter's Square, and Jeremy Deller's Peterloo Memorial was unveiled beside it in 2019. The marker is at the memorial

name: Milton's Cottage, Chalfont St Giles
name_zh: 查尔芬特圣贾尔斯 · 弥尔顿小屋
note: 1665 年弥尔顿和妻子为躲避伦敦的瘟疫搬进这座小屋，他在这里写完了《失乐园》。1887 年靠公众募捐买下，底层是博物馆，花园对外开放
note_en: Milton and his wife moved into this cottage in 1665 to escape the plague in London, and he finished Paradise Lost here. It was bought by public subscription in 1887; the ground floor is a museum and the garden is open
coord_checked: Milton's Cottage, Chalfont St. Giles (Geograph photo 8063115, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/8063115

name: Coleridge Cottage, Nether Stowey
name_zh: 下斯托伊 · 柯勒律治小屋
note: 柯勒律治 1797 至 1799 年租住在这里，写了《这菩提树荫是我的牢房》《古舟子咏》《午夜寒霜》和《克丽斯塔贝尔》的一部分。1909 年起由国民信托管理
note_en: Coleridge rented the cottage from 1797 to 1799 and wrote This Lime-Tree Bower My Prison, The Rime of the Ancient Mariner, Frost at Midnight and part of Christabel here. It has been run by the National Trust since 1909

name: Porlock
note: 埃克斯穆尔海岸边的村庄。柯勒律治在《忽必烈汗》的序言里说，1797 年他在波洛克和林顿之间一座僻静的农舍里梦到这首诗，一般认为那座农舍在卡尔伯恩教堂附近；醒来写到一半，“一位从波洛克来办事的人”上门，其余的诗句就都忘了
note_en: A village on the Exmoor coast. In his preface to Kubla Khan Coleridge says he dreamt the poem in 1797 at a lonely farmhouse between Porlock and Linton, usually placed near Culbone Church, and lost the rest of it when 'a person on business from Porlock' called

name: Farringford, Isle of Wight
note: 丁尼生 1853 年租下法林福德，1856 年买下，此后一直以这里为家，直到 1892 年去世；他在苏塞克斯盖了奥尔德沃斯之后，冬天仍回这里住。2017 年修复后作为历史名宅开放，4 月到 10 月有导览
note_en: Tennyson rented Farringford in 1853, bought it in 1856 and kept it as his home until his death in 1892, spending the winters here after he built Aldworth in Sussex. It reopened as a historic house in 2017, with guided tours from April to October
coord_checked: Farringford House, once the home of Tennyson (Geograph photo 6241203, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/6241203

name: St Andrew's Church, Clevedon
name_zh: 克利夫登 · 圣安德鲁教堂
note: 布里斯托尔海峡边小山上的老教堂，塞文河口就在这里入海。丁尼生最好的朋友阿瑟·哈勒姆，也就是《悼念集》标题里的 A.H.H.，葬在这里
note_en: The old church on a hill above the Bristol Channel, where the Severn estuary meets the sea. Arthur Hallam, Tennyson's closest friend and the A.H.H. of In Memoriam, is buried here

name: St Marylebone Parish Church
note: 罗伯特·勃朗宁和伊丽莎白·巴雷特 1846 年在这里结婚。教堂在战争中受损，1949 年重新开放时设了一间勃朗宁礼拜堂纪念这场婚礼，教区至今保存着他们的结婚证书
note_en: Robert Browning and Elizabeth Barrett were married here in 1846. When the church reopened after war damage in 1949 it made a Browning Chapel to mark the wedding, and the parish still keeps their marriage certificate
coord_checked: St Marylebone Parish Church (Wikipedia), grid ref TQ 28285 82034 — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St_Marylebone_Parish_Church

name: Temple Church and the Temple
note: 圣殿骑士团在英格兰的总部教堂，圆形，1185 年祝圣。周围舰队街和泰晤士河之间的圣殿区，现在属于内殿和中殿两所律师学院——正是斯宾塞诗里取代了圣殿骑士的“好学的律师”
note_en: The round church the Knights Templar built as their English headquarters, consecrated in 1185. The Temple around it, between Fleet Street and the Thames, now belongs to two Inns of Court, Inner Temple and Middle Temple: the lawyers who, as Spenser says, took the Templars' place
coord_checked: Temple Church (Commons photo 'Temple Church 5, London, UK - Diliff', camera location) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Temple_Church_5,_London,_UK_-_Diliff.jpg

name: John Clare Cottage, Helpston
name_zh: 赫尔普斯顿 · 约翰·克莱尔小屋
note: 克莱尔 1793 年生在林门街 12 号这座茅草屋里。赫尔普斯顿周围的田野、公地，以及公地被圈占的经过，贯穿他的诗；他葬在村里的圣博托尔夫教堂墓园。约翰·克莱尔基金会 2005 年买下小屋并加以修复，现在对外开放
note_en: Clare was born in 1793 in this thatched cottage at 12 Woodgate. The fields and commons around Helpston, and their enclosure, run all through his poems; he is buried in St Botolph's churchyard in the village. The John Clare Trust bought the cottage in 2005 and has restored it
coord_checked: John Clare Cottage, Helpston (Geograph photo 3945475, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/3945475

name: Shandy Hall, Coxwold
name_zh: 考克斯沃尔德 · 项狄府
note: 斯特恩 1760 至 1768 年在考克斯沃尔德当牧师，住在这里，写了《项狄传》后面几卷和《感伤的旅行》；《项狄传》头两卷在他搬来以前已经出版。现由劳伦斯·斯特恩基金会管理，对外开放
note_en: Sterne lived here from 1760 to 1768 as curate of Coxwold and wrote the later volumes of Tristram Shandy and A Sentimental Journey here; the first two volumes were already out. Run by the Laurence Sterne Trust and open to visitors

name: Carlyle's House, Chelsea
name_zh: 切尔西 · 卡莱尔故居
note: 托马斯和简·卡莱尔 1834 年搬进切恩街 24 号，一直住到他 1881 年去世。他在这里写了《法国革命史》和此后的大部分作品。现归国民信托所有
note_en: Thomas and Jane Carlyle lived at 24 Cheyne Row from 1834 until his death in 1881. He wrote The French Revolution and most of his later work here. Owned by the National Trust
coord_checked: Nos 16 to 22, No 24 Carlyle's House and Nos 26 to 34 Cheyne Row (British Listed Buildings, Grade II*) — https://britishlistedbuildings.co.uk/101358142-16-22-24-carlyles-house-and-26-34-cheyne-row-royal-hospital-ward

name: Cowper and Newton Museum, Olney
name_zh: 奥尔尼 · 柯珀与牛顿博物馆
note: 柯珀 1768 至 1786 年住在集市广场边的果园居。他和写《奇异恩典》的牧师约翰·牛顿合写了《奥尔尼圣诗》，1783 年又开始写长诗《任务》，诗里的风景就是小镇周围的乌斯河谷。房子现在是柯珀与牛顿博物馆
note_en: Cowper lived at Orchard Side, on the Market Place, from 1768 to 1786. With the curate John Newton, who wrote Amazing Grace, he wrote the Olney Hymns, and in 1783 he began The Task, which looks out over the Ouse valley around the town. The house is now the Cowper and Newton Museum
coord_checked: Cowper & Newton Museum, Market Place, Olney (Geograph photo 6856872, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/6856872

name: Yr Ysgwrn, Trawsfynydd
name_zh: 特劳斯维尼兹 · 伊斯古恩农场
note: 普里索谷里的山间农场，赫德·温（本名埃利斯·汉弗莱·埃文斯）在这里长大。他 1917 年 7 月 31 日战死在帕斯尚尔；同年晚些时候，他的长诗《英雄》在全国诗歌节上获得诗人椅，空着的椅子盖上了黑布。这把“黑椅子”就保存在农场里；2012 年斯诺登尼亚国家公园代表国家买下了这里
note_en: The hill farm in Cwm Prysor where Hedd Wyn (Ellis Humphrey Evans) grew up. He was killed at Passchendaele on 31 July 1917; later that year his awdl Yr Arwr won the chair at the National Eisteddfod, and the empty chair was draped in black. The Black Chair is kept here, and the Snowdonia National Park bought the farm for the nation in 2012
coord_checked: Yr Ysgwrn, home of the poet Hedd Wyn (Commons photo by Alan Fryer, object location) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3AYr_Ysgwrn%2C_cartref_y_bardd_Hedd_Wyn_-_Yr_Ysgwrn%2C_home_of_the_poet_Hedd_Wyn_-_geograph.org.uk_-_3704246.jpg

name: Seamus Heaney HomePlace, Bellaghy
name_zh: 贝拉希 · 谢默斯·希尼故里中心
note: 介绍希尼生平和作品的艺术中心，2016 年在贝拉希开幕；他家 1953 年搬到这个村子。他 1939 年生在卡斯尔道森附近的家族农场莫斯鲍恩，葬在村里的圣玛利亚教堂墓园，墓碑上写着“不顾理智，在空中行走”
note_en: An arts centre about Heaney's life and work, opened in 2016 in Bellaghy, where his family moved in 1953. He was born in 1939 at Mossbawn, the family farm near Castledawson, and is buried in St Mary's churchyard in the village, under the words 'Walk on air against your better judgement'

name: Roald Dahl Museum and Story Centre, Great Missenden
name_zh: 大米森登 · 罗尔德·达尔博物馆
note: 达尔在大米森登的吉普赛屋住了 36 年，直到 1990 年去世。博物馆设在高街上一座旧驿站客栈里，2005 年开幕，收藏着他的手稿和文件
note_en: Dahl lived at Gipsy House in Great Missenden for 36 years, until his death in 1990. The museum, in an old coaching inn on the High Street, opened in 2005 and holds his papers
coord_checked: The Roald Dahl Museum and Story Centre (Geograph photo 1264147, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/1264147

name: The sweet shop, 11 High Street, Llandaff
name_zh: 兰达夫 · 高街 11 号糖果店
note: 《好小子》里“老鼠大阴谋”发生的糖果店。1924 年，七岁的达尔和四个伙伴把一只死老鼠放进了这里的硬糖罐；店主后来成了书里的普拉切特太太。2009 年挂上了蓝色纪念牌
note_en: The sweet shop of the Great Mouse Plot in Boy. In 1924 seven-year-old Dahl and four friends put a dead mouse in a jar of gobstoppers here; the shopkeeper became Mrs Pratchett in the book. A blue plaque went up in 2009

name: Repton School
prototype_of: 不是工厂本身：1930 年代达尔在雷普顿上学时，和同学们一起替吉百利试吃新出的巧克力，他梦想将来给吉百利发明巧克力。他说《查理和巧克力工厂》就是从这里来的
prototype_of_en: Not the factory itself: at Repton in the 1930s Dahl and the other boys tested new Cadbury chocolate bars, and he dreamed of working as an inventor for Cadbury. He said this was where Charlie and the Chocolate Factory came from

name: Exeter College, Oxford
name_zh: 牛津 · 埃克塞特学院
prototype_of: 普尔曼自己读书的学院，也是乔丹学院的原型：乔丹学院的位置和布局都照着它，只是更大、更富、更古老
prototype_of_en: Pullman's own college and the model for Jordan College, which stands where Exeter does and is laid out like it, only bigger, richer and older

name: The bench in the Oxford Botanic Garden
note: 英国最古老的植物园，建于 1621 年。园子后面那张长椅——威尔和莱拉约定每年仲夏日去坐的地方——成了读者的朝圣地；2019 年起，长椅后面立着朱利安·沃伦的雕塑
note_en: Britain's oldest botanic garden, founded in 1621. The bench at the back of the garden, where Will and Lyra promise to sit every Midsummer's Day, has become a place of pilgrimage for readers; a sculpture by Julian Warren has stood behind it since 2019

name: Watership Down
note: 汉普郡北部金斯克莱尔附近的白垩丘陵，小说就以它命名。兔子们的旅程从纽伯里南边的桑德福德出发
note_en: A chalk down in north Hampshire, near Kingsclere, that gives the novel its name. The rabbits' journey starts at Sandleford, south of Newbury
coord_checked: Watership Down (Geograph photo 3111, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/3111

name: The World of James Herriot, Thirsk
name_zh: 瑟斯克 · 吉米·哈利的世界
note: 以吉米·哈利（James Herriot）为笔名写作的阿尔夫·怀特，住在柯克盖特 23 号并在这里行医；书里它是斯凯尔代尔宅，达罗比镇则是瑟斯克、里士满、莱伯恩和米德尔赫姆几个小镇的合体。1999 年改为博物馆开放
note_en: Alf Wight, who wrote as James Herriot, lived and practised as a vet at 23 Kirkgate; in the books it is Skeldale House, and Darrowby is a mix of Thirsk, Richmond, Leyburn and Middleham. The house opened as a museum in 1999
coord_checked: The World of James Herriot (Geograph photo 636931, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/636931

name: Charles Dickens Birthplace Museum, Portsmouth
name_zh: 朴茨茅斯 · 狄更斯出生地博物馆
note: 狄更斯 1812 年生在朴茨茅斯兰德港的这座房子里。1904 年起归市政府所有，1960 年代按当年的样子修复了室内，现由朴茨茅斯博物馆管理
note_en: Dickens was born in this house in Landport, Portsmouth, in 1812. The city has owned it since 1904; the rooms were restored in the 1960s, and it is run by Portsmouth Museums

name: Max Gate, Dorchester
name_zh: 多切斯特 · 马克斯门
note: 哈代自己设计了这座房子，由他的父亲和弟弟施工。他 1885 年住进来，直到 1928 年去世，在这里写了《德伯家的苔丝》《无名的裘德》《卡斯特桥市长》和大量的诗。1940 年他的妹妹凯特把房子留给了国民信托
note_en: Hardy designed the house himself and his father and brother built it. He lived here from 1885 until his death in 1928 and wrote Tess of the d'Urbervilles, Jude the Obscure, The Mayor of Casterbridge and much of his poetry here. His sister Kate left it to the National Trust in 1940

name: Samuel Johnson Birthplace Museum, Lichfield
name_zh: 利奇菲尔德 · 约翰逊出生地博物馆
note: 约翰逊的父亲迈克尔是书商，1707 年盖了这座房子，楼下开书店、楼上住家；约翰逊 1709 年 9 月 18 日生在这里。房子在市场街和面包市场街的拐角，对着集市广场，1901 年起是博物馆
note_en: Johnson's father Michael, a bookseller, built the house in 1707 as his shop and home, and Johnson was born here on 18 September 1709. It stands on the corner of Market Street and Breadmarket Street, across from the market square, and has been a museum since 1901

name: Bateman's, Burwash
name_zh: 伯沃什 · 贝特曼庄园
note: 吉卜林夫妇 1902 年买下贝特曼庄园，他在这里一直住到 1936 年去世。《普克山的帕克》就是以从屋里望得见的那座小山命名的，《如果》也是在这里写的。1939 年按他遗孀卡罗琳的遗嘱归国民信托
note_en: The Kiplings bought Bateman's in 1902 and he lived here until his death in 1936. Puck of Pook's Hill is named after the hill you can see from the house, and If— was written here too. Under his widow Caroline's will it passed to the National Trust in 1939

name: Rydal Mount
note: 华兹华斯 1813 年搬来，在这里一直住到 1850 年去世。他的玄孙女玛丽·亨德森 1969 年买下这里，1970 年对外开放；2026 年华兹华斯基金会买下了它
note_en: Wordsworth's home from 1813 until his death in 1850. His great-great-granddaughter Mary Henderson bought it in 1969 and opened it to the public in 1970; the Wordsworth Trust bought it in 2026
coord_checked: Rydal Mount (Geograph photo 3707259, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/3707259

name: Robert Burns House, Dumfries
name_zh: 邓弗里斯 · 彭斯故居
note: 彭斯 1793 年搬进这座房子（今伯恩斯街 24 号），一直住到 1796 年去世。现在是博物馆
note_en: Burns lived in this house, now 24 Burns Street, from 1793 until his death in 1796. It is now a museum
coord_checked: 24 Burns Street, Robert Burns House (British Listed Buildings, Category A) — https://britishlistedbuildings.co.uk/200362606-24-burns-street-robert-burns-house-dumfries

name: J. M. Barrie's Birthplace, Kirriemuir
name_zh: 基里缪尔 · 巴里出生地
note: 巴里 1860 年 5 月 9 日生在布里金路 9 号，是织布工家里十个孩子中的第九个。七岁时，他在屋后的洗衣房里排演了自己的第一出戏，据说《彼得·潘》里的温迪小屋就是从这里来的。现由苏格兰国民信托管理
note_en: Barrie was born at 9 Brechin Road on 9 May 1860, the ninth of ten children in a weaver's family. At seven he put on his first play in the wash-house behind it, which is said to have given him the Wendy House in Peter Pan. Cared for by the National Trust for Scotland
coord_checked: J. M. Barrie's birthplace, Kirriemuir (Geograph photo 2513632, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/2513632

name: Dylan Thomas Birthplace, 5 Cwmdonkin Drive, Swansea
name_zh: 斯旺西 · 迪伦·托马斯出生地
note: 迪伦·托马斯 1914 年生在斯旺西高地区这座房子的前卧室，一直住到 1937 年父母搬走。房子已按 1914 年的样子修复，对外开放
note_en: Dylan Thomas was born in the front bedroom of this house in the Uplands in 1914 and lived here until his parents moved out in 1937. It has been restored to how it was in 1914 and opens to visitors
coord_checked: Birthplace of Dylan Thomas in Swansea (Geograph photo 4091841, subject location) — https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/4091841

name: C. S. Lewis Square, Belfast
name_zh: 贝尔法斯特 · C. S. 刘易斯广场
note: 贝尔法斯特东区的一个广场，在康斯沃特绿道和科默绿道交会处；刘易斯就在东区长大。广场 2016 年 11 月 22 日落成，正是他去世 53 周年，广场上有莫里斯·哈伦雕的七座《狮子、女巫和魔衣橱》人物雕像
note_en: A square in east Belfast, where Lewis grew up, at the meeting of the Connswater and Comber Greenways. It opened on 22 November 2016, the 53rd anniversary of his death, with seven sculptures by Maurice Harron of characters from The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
coord_checked: C S Lewis Square and sculpture trail, Belfast (Commons photo by Simon Burchell, camera location) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3AC_S_Lewis_Square_and_sculpture_trail%2C_Belfast_01.jpg

name: Moseley Bog, Birmingham
name_zh: 伯明翰 · 莫斯利沼泽
prototype_of: 托尔金小时候就住在附近，后来说这一带是“一种失落的乐园”。他承认，《霍比特人》和《魔戒》里那些古老的森林，灵感来自这片老树林。现在是自然保护区，由伯明翰与黑乡野生动物信托管理
prototype_of_en: Tolkien lived nearby as a boy and later called the countryside here 'a kind of lost paradise'. He acknowledged these old woods as an inspiration for the ancient forests of The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings. Now a nature reserve run by the Wildlife Trust for Birmingham and the Black Country

name: 20 Northmoor Road, Oxford
name_zh: 牛津 · 北沼路 20 号
note: 托尔金 1930 至 1947 年的家。文物登录说明里写着，他在这座房子里写了《霍比特人》的全部和《魔戒》的几乎全部。现在是私宅，2004 年列为二级保护建筑，墙上有蓝色纪念牌
note_en: Tolkien's home from 1930 to 1947. The listing says he wrote the whole of The Hobbit and almost all of The Lord of the Rings in this house. It is a private house, listed Grade II since 2004, with a blue plaque
coord_checked: 20 Northmoor Road (British Listed Buildings, Grade II) — https://britishlistedbuildings.co.uk/101391361-20-northmoor-road-oxford

name: Anna Sewell's House, Great Yarmouth
name_zh: 大雅茅斯 · 安娜·休厄尔故居
note: 安娜·休厄尔 1820 年 3 月 30 日生在教堂广场 26 号。《黑骏马》是她多年以后在诺里奇附近老卡顿的家里写的，从 1871 年写到 1877 年；书出版几个月后，她于 1878 年去世。现在这座房子由红翼马匹救助站租用，2022 年起对外开放
note_en: Anna Sewell was born at 26 Church Plain on 30 March 1820. She wrote Black Beauty much later, between 1871 and 1877, at her home in Old Catton near Norwich, and died in 1878, a few months after it came out. The Redwings Horse Sanctuary leases the house and opened it to visitors in 2022
coord_checked: Anna Sewell's House, Church Plain, Great Yarmouth (Commons photo by Colin Smith, object location) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3A-2020-08-17_Anna_Sewell%E2%80%99s_House%2C_Church_Plain%2C_Great_Yarmouth%2C_Norfolk.jpg

name: Douglas Adams's grave, Highgate Cemetery
name_zh: 海格特公墓 · 道格拉斯·亚当斯墓
note: 亚当斯（1952–2001）葬在海格特公墓东园。墓前放着一罐笔，很好认
note_en: Adams (1952–2001) is buried in the East Cemetery at Highgate. The grave is easy to spot by the pot of pens in front of it
coord_checked: Douglas Adams's grave (Geograph 5847972 on Commons, object location) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3ADouglas_Adams_-_geograph.org.uk_-_5847972.jpg

name: Guildford
note: 伦敦西南、萨里郡的郡治。书里它只是个幌子：福特·普里菲克特一直让人以为他是从这里来的失业演员
note_en: The county town of Surrey, south-west of London. In the book it is only a cover story: Ford Prefect has let everyone believe he is an out-of-work actor from here
coord_checked: Guildford High Street (Geograph 3968888 on Commons, object location) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3AGuildford_High_Street_-_geograph.org.uk_-_3968888.jpg

name: Wells Cathedral
prototype_of: 《圣殿春秋》里的王桥大教堂，原型是韦尔斯大教堂和索尔兹伯里大教堂
prototype_of_en: Kingsbridge Cathedral in The Pillars of the Earth is based on the cathedrals of Wells and Salisbury

name: Deptford
note: 伦敦东南、泰晤士河南岸的一片街区，过去有皇家造船厂。威廉·比奇就是从这里来的
note_en: A district on the south bank of the Thames in south-east London, once the site of a royal dockyard. William Beech comes from here

name: Lelant, Cornwall
note: 皮尔彻 1924 年生在这个村子，村子在圣艾夫斯附近的海尔河口。西南海岸步道介绍她的康沃尔的页面说，《拾贝人》的故事发生在伦敦和莱兰特
note_en: Pilcher was born in this village on the Hayle estuary, near St Ives, in 1924. The South West Coast Path's page on her Cornwall says The Shell Seekers is set in London and Lelant

name: Peel Island, Coniston Water
name_zh: 科尼斯顿湖 · 皮尔岛
prototype_of: 野猫岛的原型之一。兰塞姆八岁时在这座岛上野餐，第一次认识了科林伍德一家；后来这家人的孙辈成了“燕子号”孩子们的原型之一。岛属于国民信托
prototype_of_en: One of the models for Wild Cat Island. Ransome first met the Collingwood family at a picnic here when he was eight, and their grandchildren helped shape the Swallows. The island belongs to the National Trust
coord_checked: Peel Island, Coniston Water (Geograph 5213528 on Commons, object location) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3APeel_Island%2C_Coniston_Water_-_geograph.org.uk_-_5213528.jpg

name: Site of Green Hedges, Beaconsfield
name_zh: 比肯斯菲尔德 · 绿篱旧址
note: 布莱顿 1938 年搬进彭路上的“绿篱”，英格兰遗产委员会说她的大部分书是在这里写的；魔法树系列 1939 至 1951 年陆续出版，正是她住在这里的时候。房子 1973 年拆掉，原址现在是布莱顿巷
note_en: Blyton moved to Green Hedges on Penn Road in 1938, and English Heritage says most of her books were written there; the Faraway Tree books came out between 1939 and 1951, while she lived here. The house was pulled down in 1973 and Blyton Close now stands on the site
coord_checked: Blyton Close, Beaconsfield, HP9 2LX (Doogal postcode map) — https://www.doogal.co.uk/ShowMap.php?postcode=HP9%202LX

name: Hastings
prototype_of: 《穿破裤子的慈善家》里的马格斯伯勒就是黑斯廷斯。特雷塞尔在这里给建筑和装修商做工，小说大部分写在圣伦纳兹伦敦路 241 号的顶层公寓里，门边有纪念牌
prototype_of_en: Mugsborough, the town in The Ragged Trousered Philanthropists, is Hastings. Tressell worked for builders and decorators here and wrote most of the novel in a top-floor flat at 241 London Road, St Leonards, which has a plaque

name: The Globe, Bedale Street, Borough
scene: 布里奇特的公寓（酒馆楼上）
scene_en: Bridget's flat, above the pub
coord_checked: The Globe, Borough (Commons photo, camera location) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3AGlobe%2C_Borough%2C_SE1_%282386237082%29.jpg

name: Platt's Lane, Hampstead
name_zh: 汉普斯特德 · 普拉茨巷
note: 威尔基·柯林斯学会按书中的路线考证，沃尔特·哈特赖特穿过汉普斯特德荒野的那次夜行，就走到了这个路口：当年写作 Pratts Lane、今天叫普拉茨巷的小路，在这里接上芬奇利路
note_en: The Wilkie Collins Society traced Walter Hartright's night walk across Hampstead Heath to this junction, where Pratts Lane (now Platt's Lane) meets Finchley Road

name: Wingfield Castle, Suffolk
name_zh: 萨福克 · 温菲尔德城堡
prototype_of: 《我的秘密城堡》里莫特曼一家住的“天赐城堡”，原型就是这座城堡。现在是私宅，不对外开放
prototype_of_en: The inspiration for Godsend Castle, the Mortmain family's home in I Capture the Castle. It is a private house and not open to the public

name: Puttenham Common, Surrey
name_zh: 萨里 · 帕特纳姆公地
note: 法纳姆和吉尔福德之间的一片荒地和树林，在帕特纳姆村南边，往埃尔斯特德方向。书里野人住的灯塔是虚构的，但书里说它在帕特纳姆和埃尔斯特德之间的山头上，北面是猪背岭
note_en: Heath and woodland between Farnham and Guildford, south of Puttenham village and towards Elstead. The Savage's lighthouse in the book is made up, but it stands on a hill between Puttenham and Elstead, with the Hog's Back to the north
coord_checked: Puttenham Common (Geograph 4027729 on Commons, object location) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3APuttenham_Common_-_geograph.org.uk_-_4027729.jpg

name: The Lady, 39–40 Bedford Street, Covent Garden
name_zh: 考文特花园 · 《淑女》杂志旧址
note: 吉本斯在《淑女》杂志做编辑助理，《寒冷舒适农场》就是她在杂志社考文特花园办公室里抽空写的；一位同事记得她为了写小说常常耽误本职工作。《淑女》杂志在贝德福德街 39–40 号一直待到 2019 年
note_en: Gibbons was an editorial assistant on The Lady and wrote Cold Comfort Farm in spare moments at the magazine's Covent Garden offices; a colleague remembered her neglecting her duties for the novel. The Lady was at 39–40 Bedford Street until 2019

name: Lincoln Cathedral
prototype_of: 安雅·塞顿《凯瑟琳》的主人公凯瑟琳·斯温福德确有其人，晚年住在大教堂的教堂区里。她和女儿琼·博福特合葬在这里，墓在天使唱诗堂的南侧
prototype_of_en: The real Katherine Swynford, heroine of Anya Seton's Katherine, lived in the cathedral close in later life. She is buried here with her daughter Joan Beaufort, on the south side of the Angel Choir

name: Crown House, Great Missenden
prototype_of: 罗尔德·达尔博物馆的村庄步道说，高街 70 号这座木结构老房子是《好心眼儿巨人》里苏菲那家孤儿院的原型。现在是私宅
prototype_of_en: The Roald Dahl Museum's village trail says this timber-framed house at 70 High Street inspired Sophie's orphanage in The BFG. It is a private home
coord_checked: Crown House, Great Missenden (British Listed Buildings, Grade II) — https://britishlistedbuildings.co.uk/101124792-crown-house-great-missenden

name: Great Missenden Library
prototype_of: 博物馆的村庄步道说，这就是玛蒂尔达常来的那座图书馆：妈妈去艾尔斯伯里打宾果，她就到这里来。现在的房子建于 1970 年
prototype_of_en: The museum's village trail says this is the library Matilda visited while her mother went off to Aylesbury to play bingo. The building dates from 1970
coord_checked: Great Missenden Library (Geograph 8112772 on Commons, object location) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3AGreat_Missenden_Library_-_geograph.org.uk_-_8112772.jpg
